cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(HarborGpu VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES for supported deployment GPUs")
endif()
find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)
add_executable(harbor_gpu main.cu)
set_target_properties(harbor_gpu PROPERTIES CUDA_STANDARD 17 CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES)
target_link_libraries(harbor_gpu PRIVATE CUDA::cudart)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME device_smoke COMMAND harbor_gpu)
install(TARGETS harbor_gpu RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
